titleEn: eSIM for Kenya – Stay Connected on Safari and Beyond
contentEn:
Travel Kenya Without Connectivity Worries

Kenya is one of Africa's premier destinations – the Masai Mara Great Migration, Mount Kenya's snow-capped peaks, and Diani Beach's white sands. With Sim2Me's eSIM for Kenya, you can share that lion sighting in real time and navigate between lodges without burning through your roaming budget.

Why Choose Sim2Me?

  • Coverage on Safaricom – Kenya's dominant carrier and one of Africa's best networks.
  • 4G LTE in Nairobi and all major towns.
  • Activate before flying into JKIA (Jomo Kenyatta International).
  • Straightforward setup, no local knowledge required.

Network Performance in Kenya

4G LTE in Nairobi, Mombasa, Kisumu, and Nakuru. 3G along the Nairobi–Naivasha–Nakuru corridor and in the Masai Mara area. Data speeds adequate for maps and photo sharing in national parks.

Quick Installation Guide

  • QR code delivered by email.
  • Scan and add plan on your device.
  • Safari time – connected!
